title: Sample Separate Account A SMA (excerpt)
summary: Sample Separate Account A · Separate account · effective March 31, 2023

evidence.quote: This Agreement establishes Sample Separate Account A, a separate account managed for the Client by the Manager.
The Client is Fictional Insurance Company.
The Manager commits 10% of the total equity and the Client the balance.
The Manager is paid an asset management fee of 1.25% per year of invested equity.
The Manager is paid an asset management fee of 1.25% per year of invested equity.
The asset management fee is paid to the Manager, the sponsor.
Property management is carried out by the Manager, the sponsor, for a fee of 5% of each property's revenue.
Construction management is carried out by the Manager, the sponsor, for a fee of 1.5% of construction spending.
Distributions are made first to the parties in proportion to their capital until each has received a preferred return of 8% per year and the return of its capital.
There is no catch-up to the Manager: the catch-up is 0%.
Distributions are then split 80% to the capital and 20% to the Manager as promote until the Client has achieved a 14% IRR, and thereafter 70% and 30%.
Each split applies only to the distributions made within its tier, and no split applies retroactively to distributions already made.
The investment period is 3 years from March 31, 2023.
The term is 7 years from March 31, 2023.
The term may be extended 2 times with the Client's consent.
